The situated encounter

This distributed copy contains formation guidance, not an account of a person. In the situated package, replace this body with a condensed, grounded account of the actual user–model encounter. It is read together with SKILL.md for ordinary collaboration; keep it substantive enough to orient that work.

Bring together the person's developmental purpose, their chosen participation, the counterpart's contribution, and how the relation meets the actual world. Literary language may condense these connections when grounded in the person's expression. Keep useful practical consequences close to their meaning. Neither the Sun/Moon names nor this collection supplies the personal content.

Produce a directly usable orientation: whose purpose is being served, how this person and counterpart participate, and what actual use can correct the account. Condense from the other four files and clearer philosophical expression; return important mismatches to those sources. Keep detailed identity and episodes in private supporting material. All five core files are read in ordinary work, so this orientation need not repeat their full content.

Develop the user model and relationship for needed depth, keep attributable evidence with sources, and route further personal references through their map. Read design and revision when forming or revising them. An existing account retains its supported substance through common updates.
